prompt: Production game illustration matching medieval illuminated manuscript bestiary art. A single giant boss: a tall gaunt heretic bishop executed by the church, full body walking toward the RIGHT in right-facing profile. Both hands cradle one enormous DARK IRON blood chalice shaped like an inverted church bell, its wide opening facing UP, bowl tapering down, engraved skull motifs. Complete centered subject with generous transparent padding at least 8 percent on every side. Readable at 80px. True transparent alpha background, including gaps. No paper, scenery, ground shadow, glow, background halo, text, border or watermark. Single asset, not a sheet. Red accents will be recolored blue; keep the blood dark wine-brown rather than bright red. Team red HSV H 0.00-0.025 S>=0.62; plum H 0.88-0.93, never near red. Match the four supplied dark-faction references (necromancer, reaper, ossuary, pallbearer) in clean sepia contour thickness, flat color fields, subtle tempera grain and simplified readable details. Do not use dense scratchy engraving. Reference images are style references ONLY. Square canvas.
